status: proposed; not human validated; not a recoding of historical labels
unit: One bank-specific scenario version, focal action, comparison action and wording; actor and counterpart identified explicitly or unknown.

interaction_mechanisms.note: Labels can overlap; target and reference may both be social. Exchange does not automatically mean reciprocity.

goal_relation.note: Record broad versus immediate goals; shared and distinct can coexist at different levels.

contribution_dependency.note: Specify the outcome and both agents' contributions; participating in a chosen joint action alone is not necessity.

incremental_effect.note: Record explicitly stated versus inferred outcomes and named baseline. No global utility inference from one metric.

actor_cost.note: No stated cost is not zero cost; risk is not a realized loss.

reciprocity.note: Distinguish sequential reciprocity, mutual benefit, direct exchange, and reputation incentives.

goal_or_action_harm.note: Specify affected party; coordination can be harmful.

perspective_and_authority.note: Who controls action and whether counterpart consents must be separate facts.

lexical_pragmatic_framing.note: Quote cues and distinguish stated consequences from wording-only tone; a beneficial action is not automatically framing bias.

evidence_status.note: Every judgment requires source-located evidence and uncertainty. Author payoff metadata and model-visible prose are different evidence layers.

independence_caveat: Dimensions can overlap or be dependent by construction. Their independence is an empirical question; no claim that each is a latent trait.
